description: This file defines interfaces and components related to Fastboot configuration within the Cuttlefish project, including abstract classes, feature flags, and dependency injection components using the Fruit library.

classes.name: FastbootConfig
classes.description: Abstract interface for Fastboot configuration, providing methods to check and set proxy fastboot status.

classes.name: FastbootConfigFragment
classes.description: A configuration fragment class related to Fastboot, inherits from ConfigFragment.

classes.name: FastbootConfigFlag
classes.description: A feature flag class for Fastboot, inherits from FlagFeature.

methods.name: FastbootConfig::~FastbootConfig
methods.description: Virtual destructor for the FastbootConfig interface.

methods.name: FastbootConfig::ProxyFastboot
methods.description: Pure virtual method to check if proxy fastboot is enabled.

methods.name: FastbootConfig::SetProxyFastboot
methods.description: Pure virtual method to enable or disable proxy fastboot.

methods.name: FastbootConfigComponent
methods.description: Function returning a component providing FastbootConfig.

methods.name: FastbootConfigFlagComponent
methods.description: Function returning a component with required dependencies including FastbootConfig and ConfigFlag, and providing FastbootConfigFlag.

methods.name: FastbootConfigFragmentComponent
methods.description: Function returning a component requiring FastbootConfig and FastbootConfigFragment.

methods.name: LaunchFastbootComponent
methods.description: Function returning a component requiring KernelLogPipeProvider, CuttlefishConfig::InstanceSpecific, and FastbootConfig.
